description: Domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS): registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, domain age in days, status flags and nameservers. Useful for trust and fraud checks. Takes 1-4 s. Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.003 per call, with card credits (access_key) or x402.

access_key.description: Prepaid credit key (cs_live_...) bought by card at https://www.aypiai.online/credits. Works on every tool; each call deducts its price.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: domain_whois
title: Domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS)
